final_message:
Fixed. `postSlug("Crème brûlée recipes")` now returns `creme-brulee-recipes`, and `npm test` passes all 3 tests, including `test/blog-slug.test.js`.

The change is in `src/blog/slug.js`. The wrapper now decomposes accented letters (NFD) and strips the combining accent marks before calling slugify. I didn't edit `vendor/slugify`, since its header and `vendor/README.md` say never to edit vendored code by hand.

The same vendored slugify is also used by `src/shop/product-url.js`, so product URLs still drop accented letters. I left that alone because it's outside this task. If you want it fixed too, the same normalization would work there, or the vendored library could be upgraded through the platform team.
